name: Arrow Salvo
body:
School conjuration; Level magus 6, shaman 6, sorcerer/wizard 6

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, F (a ranged weapon)

EFFECT

Range medium (100 feet + 10 ft./level)
Area 30-foot-radius burst
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Reflex half; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

You conjure an massive version of the ranged weapon used as a focus that launches a salvo of attacks into an area. All creatures within the area must make a Reflex save or take 1d10 damage per 2 levels to a maximum of 10d10 at 20th caster level. The damage dealt by this spell matches the base damage type of the weapon used but is considered magic for the purposes of damage reduction. A successful Reflex save halves this damage. If the target fails their Reflex save by 10 or more, they are knocked prone in addition to the damage.
